t: Bar diverter shower suitable for high pressure systems including combi boilers. Offering the options of using the 190mm overhead drench head shower, or diverting the flow to the 109mm shower handset with 3-spray patterns. Features integral diverter for a slimline, sleek appearance, thermostatic temperature control for safe showering and 'cool touch' to ensure that the valve remains comfortable to touch.
b: Suitable for High Pressure Water Systems Only
